stories.title: Taylor Swift crashes Dakota Johnson's SNL monologue
stories.summary: Taylor Swift walked on unannounced during Dakota Johnson's opening monologue on Saturday Night Live, playing the friend Johnson jokingly calls her therapist, and brought her a cake for her birthday the next day. Pop Base's photo of the two got 60K likes, "SNL Taylor Swift" was one of the weekend's top Google searches, and fan clips of the studio audience screaming kept circulating through Sunday.
